meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 它读取 claude-mem 记录的项目开发时间线,生成名为「Journey Into 项目名」的叙述式报告(约 3000~6000 字),涵盖项目起源、架构演变、关键突破等板块,并存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、项目历史分析、开发历程等,且 claude-mem worker 在运行、项目已有记录时触发。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份时间线报告
say.note: 会拉取该项目完整时间线并生成报告

say.text: 分析一下我这个项目的完整开发历程
say.note: 先确认项目名与 token 用量再继续

say.text: 给这个项目做一份完整项目报告
say.note: 结果存为本地 markdown 文件

howto.what_en: It reads the project timeline stored in claude-mem and writes a narrative 'Journey Into [project]' report (about 3,000-6,000 words) covering genesis, architecture, breakthroughs and more, saved as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or development journey, and the claude-mem worker is running with recorded observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and writes the report

say_en.text: Analyze my project's full development history
say_en.note: Confirms project name and token cost first

say_en.text: Give me a full project report for this project
say_en.note: Saves the result as a local markdown file
